title: UPPER PUSH & POSTURE
subtitle: TUESDAY EASE. GENTLE PUSH. TALL POSTURE.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Tuesday is gentle upper push and posture — a small break from the desk, nothing heroic. About eleven minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. Soft push, a bit of posture, and you showed up. Enjoy your day — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED OVERHEAD PRESS
exercises.cue: Sit tall in a sturdy chair. Light hand weights or empty hands. Press gently overhead, then lower with control. Soft elbows — only a comfortable range. Smaller height is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated overhead press. Two sets of eight. Sit tall, press gently overhead, lower with control. Empty hands or light weights are fine. Keep it soft.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Stay seated. Easy breath.

exercises.name: WALL PUSH-UPS
exercises.cue: Hands on the wall at shoulder height. Feet comfortable. Bend the elbows and press away with control. Keep the body long and soft. Smaller range is perfect on a sore day. No floor work.
exercises.speakStart: Wall push ups. Two sets of eight. Hands on the wall, bend the elbows, press away softly. Stay tall. Only as deep as feels kind.
exercises.speakRest: Thirty seconds. Soften the shoulders. Breathe easy.
exercises.speakDone: Wall push ups done. You're doing well.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Light weights or empty hands. Draw elbows back as if rowing, squeeze the shoulder blades gently, then release. Soft on the neck. Stay seated the whole way.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row. Two sets of eight. Sit tall, draw the elbows back softly, squeeze the shoulder blades, then release. Easy on the neck.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Stay seated. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED FORWARD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall on the chair. Hinge gently from the hips with a long spine. Reach toward your shins — stop well short of pain. Smaller range is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated forward reach. Two holds of twenty seconds. Sit tall, hinge softly from the hips, long spine. Only as far as feels kind.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Sit upright and breathe.
exercises.speakDone: Forward reach done. That's the session — lovely work.
